given: a warehouse operator on the stock form (create/edit)
then: batch_number and serial_number are presented as two separate, independently labeled input fields the operator can view and manage on their own, rather than one combined tracking-code input

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the read-only list view shows the two fields separately; this AC asserts the form (input) view exposes them as separate inputs. A build could update the list rendering while leaving the form with a single combined-code input, passing AC1 but failing here, so the two surfaces are independently observable and breakable.
